primary_dataset.regeneration: Deterministically regenerated from the frozen Gate report and its 182 verified segment datasets.

replication.partition_rule: Use the PRIMARY BTC wall-time boundaries unchanged; ETH outcomes cannot move partitions or choose the champion.
replication.selection_role: No ETH result may select, tune, reverse, or rescue a BTC hypothesis.

timing.causal_rule: All feature source availability timestamps must be <= the decision cursor in the same host/boot domain. Future gap knowledge and retrospective repair are forbidden.

context_only.hl_spread_bps: 10000 * (ask - bid) / ((ask + bid) / 2) at the decision BBO

H1.availability: current = latest Binance BBO at/before decision; anchor = latest Binance BBO at/before decision-5s; both same host/boot and <=2s stale
H1.action: value > 0 => LONG; value < 0 => SHORT; zero/missing => ABSTAIN

H2.equation: (bid_size - ask_size) / (bid_size + ask_size) using the exact decision Hyperliquid BBO
H2.action: value > 0 => LONG; value < 0 => SHORT; zero/missing => ABSTAIN

label.name: signed_primary_mid_return_50s_bps
label.zero_direction: Excluded from directional-accuracy denominator but retained in complete opportunity accounting.
label.invalid_future_interval: Recorded as outcome invalid/missing only; never exposed to the decision feature view.

power_plan.note: Normal-approximation counts are planning floors; directional hit rate is not the optimization target.

partitions.derivation: PRIMARY decision-time feature availability only; outcome values are not consulted; equal wall timestamps stay in the later partition.

development.outcome_use: Implementation/data-quality checks only. Any outcome-informed protocol change requires a new protocol version and new untouched confirmation.

controls.no_trade: TASK-019 NoTradePolicy on identical opportunity rows
controls.randomized_direction: TASK-019 RandomizedDirectionPolicy on identical opportunity rows

trial_registry.runner_up_rule: If the selection champion fails untouched confirmation, no runner-up may be tested on that same confirmation partition.

selection_and_stopping_rules.evaluable_directional_row: Registered feature ready, deterministic action LONG/SHORT, outcome available, and outcome direction is +/-1.
selection_and_stopping_rules.iid_reference_test: Exact one-sided binomial upper-tail under p=0.50 at alpha=0.025; report as an IID reference, not as a formal guarantee when serial dependence exists.

dependence_diagnostic.series: chronological correctness indicator on evaluable rows
dependence_diagnostic.adjusted_lower_bound: One-sided 97.5% Wilson lower bound using observed hit fraction and effective_n; a conservative diagnostic, not a formal IID confidence guarantee.

selection_and_stopping_rules.necessary_economic_filter: Mean TASK-019 partial-known-cost PnL per TRADED opportunity must be > 0 under the frozen 4.5 bps/side fee SCENARIO and executable bid/ask prices.
selection_and_stopping_rules.selection_pass: Requires minimum evaluable support, IID-reference p <= 0.025, dependence-adjusted lower bound > 0.50, and positive mean partial-known-cost PnL.
selection_and_stopping_rules.champion: Among selection-pass hypotheses, highest dependence-adjusted lower bound wins; exact tie breaks lexicographically by hypothesis_id.
selection_and_stopping_rules.confirmation_pass: The single frozen champion must independently satisfy confirmation minimum support, IID-reference p <= 0.025, dependence-adjusted lower bound > 0.50, and positive mean partial-known-cost PnL.
selection_and_stopping_rules.confirmation_fail: STOP_FAIL_SIGNAL_CONFIRMATION; no runner-up on this holdout.
selection_and_stopping_rules.optional_stopping: Forbidden. No peeking-based early success, no threshold/window/sign changes, and no additional hypothesis after registered results are observed.

business_net_boundary.reason: Actual project-account fee tier, realized submit-to-fill latency, own-order impact/slippage, and boundary-aligned funding remain unsupported/UNKNOWN.
business_net_boundary.later_gate1_hurdle: Positive fully-accounted business-net expectancy with all required costs measured/observed and a dependence-aware lower uncertainty bound above zero on locked confirmation evidence.
